title: Studio
subtitle: Maude app-shell redesign — the dotted canvas framed by one cohesive chrome material
brief: Redesign of the Maude desktop app from today's reality + Canvas Viewport. Layout the user likes: left sidebar (file tree) · top menubar+tools+status · bottom context bar · right sidebar (comments / inspector / css knobs). Covers the implemented feature surface across 6 artboards, with light interactions on the hero so the chrome is visible in motion.
